meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让配音和背景音乐不再互相盖住,把音量、淡化与效果调到刚好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频旁白总被背景音乐压住,或需要给多条音轨统一调音。
copy.tagline_en: Balance voiceover against music and shape fades, ducking and effects per track.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover keeps getting buried by the music and you need it fixed.

howto.what: Claude 会给已放入 HyperFrames 合成的音频做混音：淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道增益与音量自动化、人声闪避、效果链和自动化包络，也能用一个 <hf-audio-group> 总线带多条轨道。预览与渲染同一套实现。
howto.when: 当你已有音频放进 HyperFrames 合成、要调淡入淡出、ducking 或效果链等混音时触发。取素材或生成音频找 /media-use，剪辑时间线找 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 把这条音乐床在人声下面做闪避，别把整条压下去
say.note: 在音乐轨上做 voiceover carve

say.text: 给旁白轨加 80Hz 高通，并去掉句子间的房间底噪
做人声淡出和音乐交叉淡化，并接到一条 hf-audio-group 总线上
say.note: 写淡入淡出与总线路由

howto.what_en: Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, crossfades, track gain, volume/effect automation, voiceover carve, and effect chains (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, delay, reverb).
howto.when_en: Triggered when audio already sits in a HyperFrames composition and you want mixing: fades, ducking, effect chains, automation. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing is /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Duck the music bed under the voice instead of turning it all down
say_en.note: Applies a voiceover carve on the music track

say_en.text: High-pass the narration at 80 Hz and gate the room tone between phrases
Fade the voice out and crossfade the music through one hf-audio-group bus
say_en.note: Writes fades and a submix bus
